Definition: to sixth or divide into sixths
BiblicalUsage: To give the sixth part is the measure of the oblation: the sixth part of an ephah of an homer of wheat, and the sixth part of an ephah of an homer of barley. One verse sets the portion, and the portion is the offering.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the sixth part is a reminder that the offering is measured, not guessed, for God told them exactly how much, and I hold that He still asks for a measured gift, not a careless one.
